title: SPECIAL COVERAGE: Impeachment trial of Sara Duterte
summary: Rappler brings live updates, analysis, and commentary from reporters and experts as the historic impeachment trial unfolds

blocks.caption: SPECIAL COVERAGE: Impeachment trial of Sara Duterte

blocks.text: Rappler brings live updates, analysis, and commentary from reporters and experts as the historic impeachment trial unfolds

MANILA, Philippines – The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte began on Monday, July 6. All eyes are on the Senate which has been convened as an impeachment court, with senators sitting as trial judges.
Rappler’s special coverage brings updates, analysis, and commentary from a panel of reporters and experts, hosted by Rappler columnist John Nery.
Rappler multimedia reporters Jairo Bolledo, Dwight de Leon, and Patrick Cruz are at the Senate, bringing you eyewitness coverage of the historic trial.
Bookmark this page to watch Rappler’s special coverage.
Follow our real-time updates in the Impeachment Trial chat room on the Rappler app, where you can interact with Rappler journalists and fellow readers. – Rappler.com
